run_linear_probe_training: run linear probe training on a frozen ViT model for image classification on ImageNet
run_linear_probe_evaluation: evaluate a frozen ViT model with a linear probe classifier on validation images
run_distributed_linear_probe: run distributed linear probe training across multiple GPUs with gradient accumulation
run_resume_linear_probe: resume linear probe training from a saved checkpoint at a specific epoch
run_linear_probe_with_finetune: run linear probe training by loading a pre-trained MAE checkpoint and freezing the backbone
